blocks.text: The Usage page provides actionable insights into an organization's usage patterns between users and applications. To provide more granular details, you can categorize the collected data based on application segments, segment groups, or user groups to review similarities across your organization.
Usage insights provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Present usage patterns of the application across an organization.
Analyze granular details of usage patterns based on segment groups, user groups, and users.
Review usage patterns to design better access policy rules.
Download reports of private application usage on a quarterly cadence.

blocks.text: On the Usage page (Data Explorer > Private Access > Usage), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Click Settings to configure report distribution.
Go to the Application and User Group Relationships page to view insights into which application segments are accessed by which user groups.
Go to the Policy Usage page to view insights into actively used policy rules.
Go to the Application Segments Usage page to view insights into actively used application segments.
Go to the Quarterly Business Review (QBR) Reports page to view quarterly insights on private application usage.
Go to the Where are my apps being served from? page to view hosting providers and analytical details of the App Connectors that have been serving your applications for the last quarter.
Go to the Business Continuity Insights page to view how Business Continuity helps keep your workforce productive, secure, and seamlessly connected, regardless of any disruption.
